column1: 22097§scent§sent§n. 香味；气味vt. 嗅到；察觉§Doctors mix light, sounds, breezes and scents to stimulate the patients.§医生同时采用光、声音、微风和香味来刺激病人。
22098§hitherto§ˌhɪðəˈtuː§adv. 到目前为止，迄今§Hitherto, virtually all photographers developed and printed their own pictures.§事实上，到目前为止，所有的摄影师都亲自冲印自己拍摄的照片。
22099§accomplish§əˈkʌmplɪʃ§vt. 达到（目的）；完成（任务）；实现（计划、诺言等）§We must accomplish the task before noon.§我们必须在中午之前完成这项任务。
22100§bullet§ˈbʊlɪt§n. 枪弹，子弹§In reaction to the forward discharge of bullets, the gun moves backward.§发射子弹所产生的后坐力会使枪向后动一下。
22101§rural§ˈrʊərəl§adj. 农村的，乡村的§Technological advance will bring about the decline of rural industries and an increase in urban populations at the same time.§科技进步将会导致农村产业的衰退，同时会带来城市人口的增长。

22102§enclosure§ɪnˈkləʊʒə(r)§n. 四周有篱笆（或围墙等）的场地，围场；（信中的）附件§Overseas trade, colonial plunder and the enclosure movement had accumulated abundant capital for greedy capitalists in Western countries.§海外贸易、殖民掠夺和圈地运动为西方贪婪的资本家积累了雄厚的资本。
22103§discontinue§ˌdɪskənˈtɪnjuː§v. 停止；中断；不连续§Without first consulting their health care provider, patients shall not discontinue the use of these medication.§在没有咨询过医护人员之前，患者不应该中断使用这些药物。
22104§revegetate§riːˈvedʒɪˌteɪt§v. 再生长，再植§To revegetate is to replant and rebuild the soil of disturbed land.§再植是指重新种植植物，复原被破坏的土壤。

22105§sustainable§səˈsteɪnəbl§adj. 可以忍受的；足以支撑的；养得起的；可持续的§As a win-win technology between human and nature, green science and technology is the essential way to sustainable development.§作为一种能使人与自然双赢的科学技术，绿色科技是通向可持续发展的必由之路。

22106§dispersal§dɪˈspɜːsl§n. 散布，分散；消散，疏散§After receiving the fire alarm, the firefighters rushed to the scene and quickly finished the dispersal of the crowd that had gathered.§接到火警后，消防人员迅速赶到现场，紧急疏散聚集的人群。
22107§fabulous§ˈfæbjələs§adj. 寓言中的；巨大的；极好的§There is a fabulous performance this weekend in accordance with the poster.§海报上说，这周末有一场很棒的演出。
22108§retailing§ˈriːteɪlɪŋ§n. 零售业§With the developing and popularizing of retailing, brand has changed into a symbol of products reputation for these manufacturers.§随着零售业的发展和普及，品牌变成制造商产品声誉的象征。
22109§rental§ˈrentl§n. 租金额；出租，租赁 adj. 租用的；出租（业）的§Having one of these following cases, lessor shall terminate rental agreement in advance.§如有下列情形之一，出租人可以提前终止房屋租赁合同。
22110§fraught§frɔːt§adj. 充满…的；担心的，烦恼的§The earliest operations employing this technique were fraught with dangers.§最早采用这一技术的手术充满了危险。

22111§obsession§əbˈseʃn§n. 迷住；困扰；萦绕于心的事物或人；固执的念头§It is said that General Charles De Gaulle had an obsession with Mona Lisa which is one of the masterpieces of the Renaissance.§据说戴高乐将军对《蒙娜丽莎》这幅文艺复兴时期的名作非常着迷。
22112§ethereal§ɪˈθɪəriəl§adj. 优雅的；轻巧的；缥缈的§Entering the resort and breathing the clear and ethereal air, you will find yourself strolling in a haven of peace.§进入度假胜地，呼吸着清新缥缈的空气，你就发现自己仿佛进入了世外桃源。

22113§unobtrusive§ˌʌnəbˈtruːsɪv§adj. 不显著的，不引人注目的；不张扬的§Listening to some quiet and unobtrusive music is one of the ways for me to find the inner tranquility after a long day.§漫长的一天过后，听一些轻柔平和的音乐是我寻求内心平静的方式之一。

22114§underpin§ˌʌndəˈpɪn§vt. 加固…的基础；加强，巩固§The Copenhagen Conference appeals to all developed countries to reduce emissions by at least 80% in the same period and underpin these efforts through robust and comparable mid-term reductions.§哥本哈根会议呼吁所有发达国家在同一时期内至少减排80%，同时通过中期有力的类似减排措施来巩固这一成绩。
22115§nutritional§njuˈtrɪʃənl§adj. 营养的，滋养的；营养物的，食物的§This book provides nutritional information on over 3,000 different food.§这本书介绍了有关三千多种食物的营养知识。

22116§velocity§vəˈlɒsəti§n. 速度，速率；迅速，快速§The parameters involved in this essay includes mass ratio, initial relative impact velocity, absolute mass and relative acceleration.§这篇论文涉及的参数有：质量比、初始相对碰撞速度、绝对质量和相对加速度。

22117§unveil§ˌʌnˈveɪl§v. 揭去面纱或覆盖物；揭幕；首次公开、揭露或展示（某事物）§The municipality decided to unveil its 2020 budget plan finally after several rounds of seminars with lawmakers and economic experts.§经过与立法者和经济学家数回合的研究讨论，市政当局终于决定公布2020年的预算方案。
22118§prototype§ˈprəʊtətaɪp§n. 原型，蓝本§Though still in prototype phase, the gloves seem to have impressed the experts.§尽管仍处于原型阶段，这种手套似乎给专家们留下了深刻的印象。
22119§swivel§ˈswɪvl§v. （使）旋转 n. 转环；转节§The old man sat down on a squeaky swivel chair and dozed fitfully.§老人坐在嘎吱作响的转椅里，断断续续地打着瞌睡。

22120§replicate§ˈreplɪkeɪt§vt. 重复，复现或复制；再制造；再生§A new computer virus was reportedly found in the new operating system by replicating themselves and passing along from user to user.§据报道，在新的操作系统中发现了一种新型电脑病毒，它通过自我复制在电脑用户间传播。
22121§capsize§kæpˈsaɪz§v. （使船）翻，倾覆§Things are always contradictory and interdependent to each other, as water can carry the boat, but it can also capsize it.§事物总是相互对立又相互依存的，正如“水能载舟，亦能覆舟”。
22122§project§ˈprɒdʒekt§n. 计划，方案；课题，项目；工程[prəˈdʒekt] v. 放映；投射，发射；（使）突出，（使）伸出；设计，规划§I think this project could be adapted to suit any age.§我觉得可以将该计划加以改动以适合所有年龄的人群。
22123§thorny§ˈθɔːni§adj. 多刺的；痛苦的，棘手的§This thorny problem on environmental protection floored the new mayor.§这个关于环境保护的棘手问题把新市长难住了。
22124§eligible§ˈelɪdʒəbl§adj. 符合条件的；合适的§You are eligible for a student loan if you are a UK resident.§如果你是英国居民，就可以申请学生贷款。
22125§admit§ədˈmɪt§v. 承认；准许…进入；准许…加入§Bill was forced to admit that he had cheated on the test.§比尔被迫承认他在考试中作弊了。
22126§bacterial§bækˈtɪəriəl§adj. 细菌的；由细菌引起的§Leaving any remaining nonviable tissue may create an environment for bacterial growth.§留下任何残存的死组织都可能为细菌生长创造环境。
22127§management§ˈmænɪdʒmənt§n. 管理（部门、人员）；处理§Why do you think that some changes have come about in the national revenue management ?§你为什么会认为国家税收管理发生了改变呢？

22128§enrolment§ɪnˈrəʊlmənt§n. 登记（人数），注册（人数）；入学，入伍§When you apply for a student loan, most banks ask you to bring your passport and your letter or certificate of enrolment.§申请学生贷款的时候，很多银行会要求你随身携带护照、入学介绍信或入学证明。
22129§strategy§ˈstrætədʒi§n. 战略，策略§The Ottawa Charter presents fundamental strategies and approaches in achieving health for all.§《渥太华宪章》提出了实现全民健康的基本策略和方法。
22130§emerge§ɪˈmɜːdʒ§vi. 出现；显露，（事实等）暴露§A new style of architecture emerged to reflect more idealistic notions for the future.§一种新的建筑风格出现了，它反映了未来更为理想的建筑理念。
22131§submerge§səbˈmɜːdʒ§v. 浸没；潜入水中§The city was submerged by the flood.§这座城市被洪水淹没了。
22132§mantle§ˈmæntl§n. 披风，斗篷；覆盖物；（煤气灯）纱罩；【解】外层，包膜；外表；（水库的）槽；【地】地幔 vt. 用斗篷盖；覆盖§Magma surged into the volcano from the Earth's mantle.§岩浆从地球的地幔涌入火山。
22133§overall§ˌəʊvərˈɔːl§adj. 全面的；全部的§The overall absence rate of the company is 3.6 percent in the first year.§公司第一年度的总缺勤率为3.6%。
22134§granite§ˈgrænɪt§n. 花岗岩，花岗石§This provided 7,000 cubic metres of granite to add to the island's foundations.§这为小岛地基的建设提供了7,000立方米的花岗石。
22135§approximate§əˈprɒksɪmət§adj. 近似的；大概的[əˈprɒksɪmeɪt] vt. 近似，接近§I would like to know the approximate price of this car.§我想了解一下这辆车的大概价位。
22136§gallery§ˈgæləri§n. 美术馆；展览馆；画廊§We'll go to the Picture Gallery with a marvellous collection of paintings all by Australian artists.§我们将前往美术馆，那里收藏了一些优秀的画作，它们全部出自澳大利亚画家之手。

22137§community§kəˈmjuːnəti§n. 社会；社区；团体；界；（动植物的）群落；共同体§Detailed surveys of social and economic trends in the European Community show that Europe's population is falling and getting older.§欧共体开展的关于社会经济趋势的详细调查显示，欧洲人口在减少且开始呈现老龄化趋势。
22138§swing§swɪŋ§v. 摇摆；（使）突然转向 n. 摇摆；秋千§The bus swung sharply to the left.§公共汽车猛地拐向左边。

22139§cite§saɪt§vt. 引用；引证；举出（示例）§Studies of the sources cited in publications lead to a conclusion: the use of foreign-language sources is often found to be as low as 10 percent.§对于出版物中引用的原始资料的研究得出了一个结论：外语资料的使用通常仅占10％。
22140§spectrum§ˈspektrəm§n. 谱，光谱，频谱；范围，幅度§Sufferers can fight back by spending a few hours each day under special, full-spectrum lamps.§患者可以通过每天在特制的全光谱灯下照射几小时来缓解身体的不适。
22141§drawback§ˈdrɔːbæk§n. 缺点；不利条件§The only drawback to the plan is the expense.§该计划的唯一缺点是费用问题。
22142§identity§aɪˈdentəti§n. 身份；特性；同一性§If people want to enter this building, their identities must be authenticated by an electronic scanner.§如果人们想进入这座大楼，需经电子扫描仪进行身份验证。
22143§trend§trend§n. 倾向；趋势；流行，时尚 vi. 伸向；倾向§In your opinion, will this trend continue into the future?§依你看，这种趋势在未来还会继续吗？
22144§extreme§ɪkˈstriːm§adj. 极度的；极端的；末端的 n. 极端，过分§One mistake we often make when stricken with extreme back pain is to go to bed and stay there.§当背部出现剧痛时我们经常犯的一个错误就是上床躺着。
22145§skip§skɪp§v. 跳，蹦；漏过；逃学§She skips the difficult words when she reads English novels.§看英文小说时她经常跳过难词。
22146§military§ˈmɪlətri§adj. 军事的 n. [the ~] 军队§The gizmo is called the Army Flashlight because it was developed initially for military use.§这种小发明被称为“军队闪光灯”，因为它最初是为军事目的研制的。
22147§vested§ˈvestɪd§adj. 法律规定的；既定的§The politicians didn't have the courage to confront the vested interest that subsidies create.§政治家们没有勇气去对抗补贴带来的既得利益。
22148§symphony§ˈsɪmfəni§n. 交响乐；和谐的东西§The audience were all enchanted by the engrossing symphony.§交响乐美妙绝伦，听众全都陶醉其中。
22149§locate§ləʊˈkeɪt§vt. 找到；位于；使坐落于；把…设置在§The college is located at London Road.§这所大学位于伦敦路
22150§classify§ˈklæsɪfaɪ§vt. 把…归类；把…分级§The researcher has classified environmental tobacco smoke in the highest risk category for causing cancer.§研究人员将环境香烟烟雾归类于最高风险致癌物。

22151§enthusiastic§ɪnˌθjuːziˈæstɪk§adj. 热情的；热心的§With lights flashing and horns honking, the newly-manufactured vehicles poured into the world like enthusiastic machines from the science-fiction movie.§车灯闪烁，喇叭轰鸣，新生产出来的汽车就像是科幻电影中充满动力的机器一样涌入大千世界。的）
22152§alter§ˈɔːltə(r)§vt. 改变；变动§We may be able to alter our genetic inheritance if we so choose.§如果愿意，我们可以改变自己的基因遗传。
22153§disqualify§dɪsˈkwɒlɪfaɪ§vt. 使丧失资格§Will this disqualify me from getting a student loan?§这会不会让我失去获得学生贷款的资格？
22154§maximum§ˈmæksɪməm§n. 最大量，极限 adj. 最大的，最高的§Students on a visitor visa or work permit may study for a maximum of 3 months.§持旅行签证或工作许可证的学生最多可有三个月的学习时间。

22155§delivery§dɪˈlɪvəri§n. 投递，交付；分娩§The invention of the motor vehicle brought personal mobility to the masses and made rapid freight delivery possible over a much wider area.§机动车的发明带来了人员的大规模流动，同时使得更大区域内的快速货运成为可能。

22156§undergraduate§ˌʌndəˈɡrædʒuət§n. 大学本科生，大学肄业生§The Universities of Oxford and Cambridge recently held joint conferences to discuss the noticeably rapid decline in literacy among undergraduates.§牛津大学和剑桥大学近期召开了几次联合会议，讨论本科生文化水平显著快速下降的问题。
22157§focus§ˈfəʊkəs§v. （使）聚焦，（使）集中 n. 焦点，焦距；（注意力、活动等的）中心§The primary focus of attention in the twentieth century has been on small-scale societies.§在20世纪，小型社会成了人们首要关注的焦点。
22158§administer§ədˈmɪnɪstə(r)§v. 管理，治理；执行，实施；给予（药物或治疗）§The personnel director administers the attendance policy.§人事经理负责考勤。
22159§ash§æʃ§n. 灰；灰烬；[pl.] 骨灰，遗骸§The volcanic ash caused a lot of damage in the village.§火山灰给村庄造成了很大的破坏。
22160§intensify§ɪnˈtensɪfaɪ§vt. 使增强；使加剧§The strong wind seemed to intensify the cold.§狂风似乎使天气更加寒冷了。
22161§inventory§ˈɪnvəntri§n. 目录；存货§Managing agents can offer a total service from reliable sourcing, managing inventory to budget control and distribution.§运营代理商可以提供从可靠货源、库房存货管理到预算控制和商品分销的全套服务。
22162§event§ɪˈvent§n. 事件；比赛项目§Your graduation from college is an important event.§你大学毕业了，这是件大事。
22163§crucial§ˈkruːʃl§adj. 决定性的；至关重要的§The presence of human beings is crucial to the survival of the forest.§人类的存在对森林的存活至关重要。
22164§stage§steɪdʒ§n. 舞台；戏剧；阶段§The next stage of the project is the design phase.§该项目的下一个阶段是设计阶段。
22165§aeration§eəˈreɪʃn§n. 通风§The tunnels abandoned by the beetles provide excellent aeration and water channels for root systems of plants.§被甲虫遗弃的地下通道为植物的根系提供了绝佳的通风和汲水管道。
22166§profitable§ˈprɒfɪtəbl§adj. 有利可图的，赚钱的；有益的§It is profitable for employers to work their existing employees hard.§雇主让他们的雇员努力工作是有利可图的。
22167§faith§feɪθ§n. 信任，信用；信仰，信条§People have to have faith in their ability to carry out the task their boss has set them.§大家必须相信自己有能力完成老板布置的任务。
22168§cafeteria§ˌkæfəˈtɪəriə§n. 自助餐馆；小餐厅§Bill had lunch in the school cafeteria.§比尔在学校食堂吃的午饭。
